First listed 2025-07-18 · episode or wrap

Earnings Season Kickoff, Bank Earnings & Nvidia China Greenlight - The Friday Market Wrap!

Eisman uses the first earnings week to demonstrate thesis checking and bank valuation. He compares tangible-equity returns across major banks, distinguishes earnings beats from stock reactions, and explains his move from GFC bearishness to a predominantly long US portfolio. Corporate observations are contemporaneous diagnoses, not newly successful forecasts.

YouTube · 2025-07-18 ↗Substack · 2025-07-19 ↗
His best contribution is relating bank profitability to valuation while explicitly acknowledging exceptions. The stronger claims about permanent safety, unique US technology exposure and Citi never recovering an old price are not precise, finite predictions. Earnings-season evidence supports resilience but does not make tariffs the only possible risk.

youtube-PZUMfLcOyYk-c003 · analytical principle

Higher sustainable tangible-equity returns generally justify a higher tangible-book multiple.

Right
Source · 4:06-5:17 ↗
SpeakerSteve Eisman
Stanceasserted
Horizonnot stated
Materialitymajor

A residual-income model links value above book to future returns exceeding the required return, holding risk and growth assumptions comparable. The observed relationship need not be exact.

Conditional reasoning

Value equals book plus the discounted value of future income above the equity charge. Higher sustainable return on the same equity base raises residual income and justified price/book.

  • Comparable risk and required return
  • Clean-surplus accounting with explicit adjustments
  • Returns are sustainable rather than a one-quarter spike

Assessment test: Compare normalized returns, cost of equity, growth and capital requirements.

Evidence and assessment details

Attribution confidence: high. Assessment confidence: medium. Thesis family: bank_valuation.

No independent empirical outcome evidence is attached. A principle, disclosure or unfinished forecast is not a verified investment win.

Source · 14:05-15:45 ↗

Stanceasserted

A valuation model depends on future income rather than a mechanical capitalization of one quarter. The specific motives of marginal investors remain unobserved.

Conditional reasoning

Two firms with equal current earnings can have different value if expected growth, risk or future margins differ. Current-quarter ROTCE alone cannot determine the price/book multiple.

  • Equity value discounts expected future distributions

Assessment test: Compare implied future returns with analyst and management forecasts.

How he reasons here

  • Use earnings to test a thesis rather than guess the next trading-day reaction.
  • Compare sustainable ROTCE with price to tangible book, then explain exceptions.
  • Separate recurring income from reserve releases and investment gains.
  • Update a market stance when bank leverage and the opportunity set change.

Tools and charts discussed

Mentioned in the transcript; visual charts have not all been inspected.

  • Annualized ROTCE
  • Price to tangible book value
  • Net interest income and margin
  • Loan-loss provisions and reserve releases
  • Trading and advisory revenue
  • Long-term asset-manager flows
  • Medical loss trends
  • Sector weights including reclassified technology businesses
